study_design: Prospective cohort study of male Adventist Health Study-2 participants, with incident prostate cancer identified through cancer-registry matching.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: This study aimed to examine the association between dietary patterns (nonvegetarian, lacto-ovo-vegetarian, pesco-vegetarian, vegan, and semi-vegetarian) and prostate cancer incidence among 26,346 male participants of the Adventist Health Study-2.
reason: The abstract reports total incident prostate cancer and does not analyze an aggressive, advanced, metastatic, high-grade, high-risk, or lethal incident endpoint.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Vegan diets showed a statistically significant protective association with prostate cancer risk (HR: 0.65; 95% CI: 0.49, 0.85).
estimate_classifications.reason: The estimate concerns overall incident prostate cancer, with no aggressive subtype specified.
